newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan computer, chip makers' 97/98 profits seen up.
newsitem.headline: Japan computer, chip makers' 97/98 profits seen up.

text.p: Japanese manufacturers of computers and semiconductors are likely see their profits rise by an average of 18 percent in the 1997/98 business year from the previous year, a Japanese business daily said.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said aggregated parent current profits of the top five computer and computer chip makers -- Hitachi Ltd, NEC Corp, Toshiba Corp, Fujitsu Ltd and Mitsubishi Electric Corp -- are expected to rise to about 490 billion yen in 1997/98, starting on April 1, from an expected 415 billion yen in 1996/97.
Fujitsu is expected to see a 50 percent rise in its profits in the next business year to 120 billion yen because of robust demand for computer networks for corporate clients, the paper said.
